# Computed reach between workspaces, not an abstract badge

> A runtime boundary contains what is inside it and does not protect what is outside — one direction is guaranteed and the other is not, so an adjective would be a lie.

Applies to `crates/bancada-core/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **A hard / soft isolation badge** (nothing refuses it) — Lies by omitting direction.
- **Formal workspace types** (nothing refuses it) — Resolves the symptom with a taxonomy; the computed fact resolves the cause.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. It is what the product computes and shows at runtime. No rule about source files can hold it.
